task.title: EACQ-FV MV3 Forward-Value Semantic Audit Delta
task.objective: Append the bounded forward-value delta to the existing Reviewer Semantic Value Audit so valuable deferred or apparently duplicate ideas cannot be silently discarded without deterministic review.
nonGoals: Do not create a new standard, checker, vocabulary family, or absorption mechanism.
Do not reclassify the 50-file MPA ledger or open UAA-G1, UAA-G2, or UAA-G3.
Do not modify roadmap, session, hook, catalog, runtime, provider, public, or deployment surfaces.
Do not commit, stage, push, publish, deploy, call providers, or use credentials.

gateA.name: SOURCE_OWNER_OVERLAP
requiredEvidence: Read the existing Reviewer Semantic Value Audit, EACQ-FV roadmap Forward-Value Review Control, R0 critique and disposition, and the MPA audit.
Confirm current doctrine already owns overlap, maturity, authority, direct-import, and composed-system review.
Confirm the only authorized delta is two questions, deterministic group selection, and two secondary dispositions.
Confirm no parallel forward-value standard or current owner exists.

gateB.name: DESIGN_CODE_TEST
requiredEvidence: Append the delta inside the existing Reviewer Semantic Value Audit section.
Cover every DEFERRED group and deterministic ownerless-or-five-row NO_NEW_VALUE or REJECTED groups in stable semantic-group order.
Define only FORWARD_VALUE_PRESERVED and NO_FORWARD_VALUE without changing terminal ledger status.
Include one positive and one negative example and prove the MPA cluster is preserved without reopening it.
Run the external-absorption core regression and worker-return fast gate.

owners.symbol: Forward-Value Review Control and MV-3 trace
competingOwnersChecked: The roadmap defines the bounded delta but must not become a second semantic-audit standard.

freshness.anchor: R0 accepted revision and MV1/MV2/L1 closures
freshness.regenerateWhen: Reviewer Semantic Value Audit or forward-value control changes

mustPreserve: Preserve all existing semantic-audit bullets verbatim unless a direct contradiction requires escalation.
Keep forward-value disposition orthogonal to terminal ledger status, maturity, authority, and implementation readiness.
Require a current conditional-reopen index row with owner and conjunctive evidence trigger for FORWARD_VALUE_PRESERVED.
Keep review order deterministic and sampling-free for the named group classes.
forbiddenTransitions: Do not promote speculative novelty into CVF authority or implementation readiness.
Do not add more than the two approved secondary dispositions.
Do not create a new standard/checker or mutate the existing conditional-reopen index.
Do not stage or commit worker changes.

freshness.anchor: final unstaged worker diff against execution base
freshness.regenerateWhen: any standard or worker-return line changes after verification

negativeCases: A DEFERRED group without an indexed conjunctive reopen condition cannot receive FORWARD_VALUE_PRESERVED.
A NO_NEW_VALUE group without an exact owner or source-backed no-value reason cannot receive NO_FORWARD_VALUE.
deterministicChecks: Ownerless or at-least-five-row NO_NEW_VALUE and REJECTED groups are selected in stable semantic-group ID order.
The MPA utility cluster is a positive example and remains parked.
An exact-owner duplicate is a negative example.
